name: composer-chip
title: Composer Chip
description: A small round chip for the chat composer's toolbar: a mode toggle such as Plan, a picker trigger such as the model, or the same words shown read-only.

meta.whenToUse: A mode or a choice in ChatComposer's toolbar: the Plan toggle, the model picker's trigger, a model shown read-only.
meta.whenNotToUse: Something that travels with the message (the composer's chips), or a filter in a toolbar (Toggle, Segmented).
